summary: Iteration 15: Verified bug fix for future-bookings availability on public website. All 13 pytest tests pass (100% backend) covering: (1) GET /api/public/availability with future dates 2026-12-20..22 returns 10 available Double rooms, (2) POST /api/public/booking/hold creates a 5-min hold with correct 30% advance payment and PayHere hash, (3) injected CRM-style booking with YYYY-MM-DD *string* check_in_date correctly excludes the room from availability (this is the exact scenario the fix addresses) while leaving non-overlapping dates untouched, (4) held rooms are excluded from availability, (5) requirements.txt pins pymongo==4.8.0 with no wheelhouse/emergent_plugins references, (6) /, /website, /refund-policy, /privacy-policy, /terms all return 200 and /website redirects to /, (7) CRM /api/auth/login with admin/admin123 succeeds. Playwright confirmed footer renders 'Made with ♥ MountEdgeTech Sri Lanka' anchored to https://mountedgetech.lk/ (opens in new tab) and Refund/Privacy/Terms footer links are present. CRM /dashboard loads and admin login works.

issues: Date inputs use the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than the shadcn Calendar/Popover. Minor UX inconsistency with the rest of the design system; not a bug.

action_items: No action required - bug fix verified. Optional: swap native <input type=date> on the hero for the shadcn Calendar for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: public_routes.py now defensively normalizes bci/bco from either str or datetime - good. Consider also handling date objects explicitly (date without time) in case CRM stores pure date; currently a bare date would hit the 'else: continue' branch and silently skip the booking.
booking_holds still store check_in/check_out as naive datetime (datetime.strptime without tz), while expires_at is tz-aware UTC. Not a correctness bug for overlap logic but should be made consistent.
payhere/notify writes check_in_date as YYYY-MM-DD string - good alignment with CRM. However customers collection still stores raw datetime from the hold - minor inconsistency.
seed_data_creation: Each test inserts and deletes its own TEST_-prefixed booking/hold documents (cleaned up in finally blocks).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bug_fix_future_bookings.py covers the string-vs-datetime date normalization fix. If date objects (not str, not datetime) ever appear in bookings, add a date-type branch in get_booked_rooms_for_dates. Preview host does not match /^app\./ so / renders the public Website. CRM is at /dashboard. Future test dates should be 2026-12-* or later.
rca of the issue: Bug: get_booked_rooms_for_dates() built a MongoDB query using Python datetime objects against check_in_date/check_out_date fields that CRM stored as YYYY-MM-DD strings. The $lt/$gt comparisons silently mismatched types, so the overlap filter effectively returned nothing on some queries and crashed overall availability for future dates. Fix (verified): fetch all active bookings (Confirmed/Checked In/Upcoming) with only room_number+dates, normalize each booking's dates in Python handling both str and datetime, then do overlap detection via (bci < co_date AND bco > ci_date). Additionally payhere/notify now writes check_in_date/check_out_date as YYYY-MM-DD strings matching CRM. Regression test test_crm_string_date_booking_excludes_room reproduces the exact failing scenario and confirms the fix works.
